objective: Add transactional, pinned Codex runtime attestation bound to contained execution
nonGoals: Build review prompts or parse provider event streams
Launch a model in automated tests
Defend against an already-compromised controller account or concurrent same-UID host attacker
acceptanceCriteria: Codex and its code-mode host are discovered from a fixed versioned path derived from the trusted account record
Both runtime files require exact reviewed sizes and hashes through bounded regular-file no-follow reads
The complete runtime is staged transactionally and a failed host or version check leaves no published destination
The runtime version is checked before an atomic publish and contained execution uses the absolute published path
The staged runtime directory is read-only inside the review service
No model runs in automated attestation tests
